book.name: Marcos
book.title: Evangelio según Marcos Jesucristo roy pjl̈ú ëre, e jyã tara Marcosdë

content: Dwl̈a sguingga

Jesús öötong sirkeno sök di bäng buk kësbang l̈i sor go ga nopga pina eshko jek obi. Nopga shrono l̈öng ara kjĩshko ga Jesús opyono kjyong roshko, ga sirkeno sök eshko. Nopga l̈i beno tjeng di bäng l̈i kjako.
Eshko ga epga pina ara l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go. Tjl̈ẽ ga
«Tja kuzĩa. Domer shäng kjl̈ara dwl̈a sguingga. Pjl̈ara ga opshino to jek dwl̈a sguing.
Sguĩyashko ga kjone kjone l̈ono tjeng irbo bäng, ga sënwa shrono, ga uara l̈ok drete.
Kjone kjone l̈ono tjeng ak ara tjrëko, kl̈ung sho ara l̇l̇ëmshko, ga weno mal̈ing, kl̈ung sho rong l̇l̇ëm kjĩshko.
Gueniyo sl̈enggwo dret kjĩshko ga dl̈o wenoshko ga sura, beno dogroe.
Dwl̈a kjrina obi, e l̈ono tjeng shkö sho roshko, ga shkö sho l̈i kunoshko ga dwl̈a l̈i l̇l̇gwĩna beno bo l̇l̇ëme.

Dwl̈a kjrina obi, e l̈ono tjeng kl̈ung sho pjl̈ú kjing go, ga kuno, botjyono pjl̈úe. Kjoneshko ga sok kjwara botjyono kjwo sak mya (30), kjoneshko ga botjyono kjwo sak tjer (60), kjoneshko ga botjyono kjwo sak dbäw (100)» l̈e.
E irgo ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong jek sira obi ga «Ëye kwomgwo tjok ga woyde ga kuya yõtso» l̈e.
Jesús tjl̈ẽno l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go erä ega

Nopga tjeng kës l̈i briktong irgo ga Jesús oppinggaga dogl̈o sak kjwara kjingsho pjök (12) l̈i, oba obl̈ë jëk l̈öng ba tjok wl̈eniyo, e tjl̈ẽ l̈ok ba kong ga «Rokërwa bop kong sira ga l̇l̇ëye l̈orop l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go yẽ, e l̇l̇ë l̈okl̈o pjl̈ol̇l̇gwes borwa kong, miydërwa wl̈o» l̈e.
Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Sbö ber no pjl̈uyo sorë l̈i roy miydaydëba l̇l̇ëm l̈i pinaba bomi kong. Gueniyo nopga obl̈ë kongda, l̈ër l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go erä.
Eni ga

content.text: »“Ĩya l̈öng kjër ga l̇l̇ë ĩyde miyde l̈ok l̇l̇ëm,
kuya l̈öng kjër ga l̇l̇ë l̈okl̈o miyde l̈ok l̇l̇ëm bakoe.
ga owa pjang ba go l̈i l̈ö̃ya ber drete”» l̈e.

content: Dwl̈a sguingga l̈anyo, e l̇l̇ë l̈okl̈o l̈ara Jesúsdë
E irgo ga Jesús tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «¿Tjl̈õkwo l̈ër shäng l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go ëre l̇l̇ë l̈okl̈o miydëmi l̇l̇ëmde? Miydëmi l̇l̇ëm ga tjl̈õkwo l̈ër l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go obi ga miydëmi l̇l̇ëm bakoe.
Dwl̈a sguingga l̈i, e Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈aga oba kong l̈i l̈okl̈o.
Kjone kjone, e so dwl̈a l̈ono tjeng irbo bäng l̈i kjoyoe. Tjl̈õkwo l̈i kuya, gueniyo Ä tjwe eshko, ga döya ba shjiryo.
»Kjone kjone, e so dwl̈a l̈ono ak ara tjrëko l̈i kjoyoe. Tjl̈õkwo l̈i kuya ga kjre l̈ok wopjl̈úe.
Gueniyo tjl̈õkwo l̈i äär ber ba pjl̈úshko jl̈õkoyo l̇l̇ëm kjĩshko ga l̇l̇ëye wen ba kong sirashko, epga shdungoba tjl̈õkwo l̈i kjĩshkoshko ga raye, söya ame.
»Kjone kjone, e so dwl̈a l̈ono shkö sho roshko l̈i kjoyoe. Tjl̈õkwo l̈i kura,

gueniyo l̇l̇ëbo tjeng kjok ëre kjing goshko l̈i woyotjl̈ĩya ara, wo pjang dbur go, l̇l̇ëbo tjeng kës l̈i kjre woydë ber ba kong wl̈o bakoe. E kjĩshko ga tjl̈õkwo l̈i woyo ba kong ame, ga bo wen tjl̈õkwo l̈i kjĩshko l̇l̇ëme.

»Gueniyo ga kjone kjone obi, e so dwl̈a l̈ono tjeng kl̈ung sho pjl̈ú kjing go l̈i kjoyoe. Tjl̈õkwo l̈i kuya, ga kjre jl̈õkoyo. E ber shäng so dwl̈a botjyono pjl̈ú kjoyoe. Kjoneshko ga sok kjwara botjyono kjwo sak mya (30), kjwo sak tjer (60), kjwo sak dbäw (100)» l̈e.
Iök shjiy
E irgo ga Jesús tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Iök borkey jong shjiy, jney l̇l̇ëbo dorko wl̈o l̇l̇ëme. Iëy jong kjókshko dey.
L̇l̇ëbo jnek tjeng l̈i, e woyde Sbörë ga ber ĩkoba wẽl̈ë wl̈o. Ga l̇l̇ono ga e ber miydëba dret, iök shjiy poyong jong kjókshko wl̈eni.
Ëye kwomgwo tjok ga woyde ga kuya yõtso.
»Ga l̇l̇ëye kumi l̈öng l̈i kuzĩ yõtso. Kumi yõtso wl̈eni ga pjãy opping ara. Kumi yõtso l̇l̇ëm wl̈eni ga pjãy opping ara l̇l̇ëme. Kumi sorë ga pjãy opping eni, ga pjãy opping e kjinmo obi.
Ëye l̇l̇ëbo tjok ga së̃ya jek obi. Ëye l̇l̇ëye l̇l̇ëm ga l̇l̇ëye tjeng sirawa l̈i döya ba shjiryo drete» l̈e.
Dwl̈a wen sorë

E irgo ga Jesús tjl̈ẽ ba kong obi ga «Sbö ber no pjl̈uyo sorë, e so dwl̈a sguina domer kjl̈ararë kjoyoe. Dwl̈a, e sguina beno kl̈ung sho kjing go, ga domer l̈i shrono iröng ba ushko. Eshko ga pë, wol̇l̇en, ga bë sök wl̈ẽpe. E wopro ga dwl̈a sguina beno tjeng l̈i weno, ga kuno, shäryë eni sorë miyde domer l̈irë l̇l̇ëm gueniyo.
Dwl̈a l̈i kun jong l̈aga kl̈ung shorë. Kun jem, korga wen, kjing shen, ga bo kwirkë shjiye.
Bo kwirkono shjiy kuzong ga domer l̈i jongya ba skok kjwl̈ë jã» l̈e.
Kjor dwl̈ayo chirawa
E irgo ga Jesús tjl̈ẽno ba kong jek obi. Tjl̈ẽ ga «¿Sbö ber no pjl̈uyo sorë, e so l̇l̇ë kjoyo? ¿L̈ër bomi kong sorë ga pjl̈ú?
E so kjor dwl̈ayo chirawa ko mostaza dgoroy kl̈ung roy kjoyoe. Dwl̈agwo ëre chirawa, dwl̈agwo obl̈ë obl̈ë dorko.
Gueniyo kun kësbang, dwl̈agwo obl̈ë obl̈ë kjinmo. Eshko ga sënwa l̇l̇ë usho ywë ba kowo go» l̈e.
Nopga pina Jesúsdë l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go eni. Kura l̈ok, gueniyo l̇l̇ë l̈okl̈o miydara l̈ok uunkong l̇l̇ëme.
Jesús tjl̈ẽno nopga kong l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go erä. Gueniyo nopga tjeng kës l̈i briktong l̈ok pjirshko ga l̇l̇ëye l̈ara l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go l̈i, e l̇l̇ë l̈okl̈o pjl̈ol̇l̇gwera ba oppinggaga kong pjire.
Pjl̈uk, di bäng buk kësbang, e ichara Jesúsdë

Kjok sëng ga Jesús sök kjyong roshko obi, ga tjl̈ẽ ba oppinggaga kong ga «Shji to dipzë, di bäng buk kësbang ëre kjwo kal̈ëkong» l̈e. Kuya l̈ok ga opyono l̈ok kjyong l̈i roy ga «Tjawa toe» l̈e l̈ok nopga kong, ga to jek ey dwayo. Eshko ga kjyong obl̈ë sökoba jek tjeng ba tjok bakoe.
Eshko ga pjl̈uk tjwe jong träk l̇l̇ëm, dbo ara di bäng buk kësbang l̈i kjing go. Di iõya ara, ga di dl̈in jong kjyong l̈i roy, pir sek seke.

Eshko ga Jesús buk pë kjyong sigwo l̈ëkong, kä iak buk kä iokl̈o kjing go. Eni ga ba oppinggaga jek l̈öng ba wol̇l̇eng, ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «¡Tjl̈apga no pingga! ¡Shji ba pitoe! ¿Pja buk wl̈ẽp ega?» l̈e.
Kuya ga kojono, ga tjl̈ẽ pjl̈uk, di iõya l̈i kong ga «Pja sl̈anzong. Pja ber tjëkso» l̈e, ga beno buk tjëkso.
Eshko ga tjl̈ẽ ba oppinggaga kong ga «¿Kjok bangkjrëmi ara ega? ¿Pjãy mär bor go l̇l̇ëm obire?» l̈e.
Eni ga epga shgawara l̈öng ara. Ga tjl̈ẽ ëng kong ga «¿Kjwe ëro? Ĩzĩa. Tjl̈ẽno pjl̈uk, di iõya l̈i kong ga kol̈e pjl̈úe» l̈e.
